items.a: An AI visibility platform: it monitors, measures, and helps improve how your brand appears in the answers of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Copilot, and Grok.
We continuously run your category's relevant questions through the leading models and analyze the generated answers — mentions, citations, list position, sentiment, and competitor presence.

items.q: Is this the same as SEO?
items.a: It's the next step. SEO fights over a list of links; AEO and GEO fight over the text of the answer. The signals overlap, but the measurement and the actions are different.

items.q: How long until I see results?
items.a: The initial diagnosis is ready in minutes. Content and authority changes usually show up in model answers within two to six weeks.

items.q: Do I need to install anything on my site?
items.a: Not to monitor. AI traffic analysis is optional and uses a lightweight script or an integration with your current analytics.

The Platform’s brand, visual identity and features are protected. Open-source components used remain governed by their respective licenses.
We make reasonable efforts to keep the Platform available, without warranty of uninterrupted operation. Maintenance windows and outages may occur, especially during the testing phase.

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil.
Questions about these Terms may be sent to the contact e-mail at the end of this page.
This Policy describes how the Ultravis platform (the "Platform") handles personal data, in compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 — LGPD).
Registration: name, e-mail and, with social login, the basic data provided by the provider (Google).
Service usage: brand data, prompts and settings you provide; technical access records (logs, IP address, session identifiers).

We process data to provide the contracted service (performance of contract), to ensure security and improve the Platform (legitimate interest), and to send operational communications about your account.
We use processors for cloud hosting, database services and querying the AI platforms we analyze. Sharing is limited to what is necessary to provide the service. We do not sell personal data.
Part of the infrastructure may be located outside Brazil. In such cases, we adopt safeguards compatible with the LGPD.
We keep data while the account is active and for applicable legal periods after closure. Analytical data may be kept in aggregated, anonymized form.
We adopt technical and organizational measures proportional to risk: encryption in transit, per-organization access control and activity logging.

You may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability, deletion and information about sharing, and revoke consent. Requests are handled through the contact channel at the end of this page.
We use essential cookies for authentication and session operation. We do not use advertising cookies.
The Platform is intended for professional use and is not directed at people under 18.
